menuActions.label: Reactivate
menuActions._note: ETP-5611 — Completed, not-posted journals can be reactivated back to Draft (GlJournalHeaderHandler routes RE through FIN_AddPaymentFromJournal). A posted journal must be unposted first.

menuActions.label: Post
menuActions._note: ETP-5611 — Post is only offered on a Completed journal (AND-combined with posted=false).

preconditions.description: Complete (CO) requires a Draft journal whose debit and credit totals are equal and greater than zero
Reactivate (RE) is rejected once the journal is posted — unpost first

edgeCases: Complete with unbalanced or all-zero lines is rejected
Reactivate on a posted journal is rejected (GLJournalDocumentPosted)
Reactivate when Open Items lines have related payments succeeds with a warning; payments are not deleted
documentAction._note: ETP-5611 — curated MCP contract override; replaces the generic documentStatus in [DR, IP] precondition inferred for every documentAction.

statusPills._note: Accounting status pill — visible to financial+admin roles only (permissions enforcement pending)

documentNo.reason: Auto-sequenced document number; read-only to the user (generated by NEO on POST).

documentType.reason: Hidden from the form but still defaulted under the hood (DocBaseType='GLJ') — needed for posting/sequencing later.

documentDate.reason: ETP-5611 — hidden and server-owned: GlJournalHeaderHandler mirrors accountingDate into it on every CRUD write (into the body on POST, onto the record on PATCH/PUT, because NEO's PATCH filter drops system fields from the body).

accountingDate.reason: ETP-5210 — accounting date is historical by nature (not a due date); the grid's past-date red-dot indicator does not apply here.

currency.reason: ETP-5611 — always the accounting schema currency (GlJournalHeaderHandler injects it on DEFAULTS and POST); manual journals are single-currency in Etendo GO.

opening.reason: Kept (cheap boolean) per spec — marks an opening-balance journal.

multigeneralLedger.reason: Kept (cheap boolean) per spec — multi-ledger flag.

businessPartner.reason: ETP-4529 — accounting dimension, config-gated (@ACCT_DIMENSION_DISPLAY@). Supersedes the prior 'not part of the simplified 7-field header form' discard. Moved from "other" to "principal" — the config-gated header dimension fields were rendering in the secondary/collapsed area instead of the main visible form.

product.reason: ETP-4529 — accounting dimension, config-gated (@ACCT_DIMENSION_DISPLAY@). Supersedes the prior 'not part of the simplified 7-field header form' discard. Moved from "other" to "principal", same rationale as header.businessPartner above.

project.reason: ETP-4529 — accounting dimension, config-gated (@ACCT_DIMENSION_DISPLAY@). Supersedes the prior 'not part of the simplified 7-field header form' discard. Moved from "other" to "principal", same rationale as header.businessPartner above.

costCenter.reason: ETP-4529 — accounting dimension, config-gated (@ACCT_DIMENSION_DISPLAY@). Supersedes the prior 'not part of the simplified 7-field header form' discard. Moved from "other" to "principal", same rationale as header.businessPartner above.

asset.reason: Header accounting dimension — not part of the simplified 7-field header form.

salesCampaign.reason: Header accounting dimension — not part of the simplified 7-field header form.

stDimension.reason: Header accounting dimension — not part of the simplified 7-field header form.

ndDimension.reason: Header accounting dimension — not part of the simplified 7-field header form.

rate.reason: CurrencyRate — derived from currency/period, not user-edited.

posted.reason: Posting status — surfaced as a readOnly status pill (Sin contabilizar/Contabilizado). Posting itself is handled via the Post/Unpost menuActions (DocumentPostingService).

documentAction.reason: DocAction button — registered in ETGO_SF_FIELD so NEO can dispatch the classic process via /action/documentAction. Hidden from the UI form; completion is triggered by the Complete button when balanced.

accountingSchema.reason: Required by gl_journal_multiacct_check; auto-injected from session $C_AcctSchema_ID by GlJournalHeaderHandler when Multi_Gl=N.

totalDebitAmount.reason: Header debit total — replaced by the live balanceFooter (Σ debit).

totalCreditAmount.reason: Header credit total — replaced by the live balanceFooter (Σ credit).

controlAmount.reason: Control amount — not used in the simplified UI.

currencyRateType.reason: Currency rate type — multi-currency rate handling out of scope for V1.

gLCategory.reason: Posting/accounting classification — not surfaced in the simplified UI.

postingType.reason: Posting-only dimension — posting deferred to workstream D.

documentStatus.reason: Document lifecycle status chip (Draft/Complete) — DF §2.1 point 2. Independent second chip alongside the accounting 'posted' pill; badge label mapping (DR->statusDraft, CO->statusComplete) comes from the shared statusBadge.js default fallback, no window-specific badge override needed.

lineNo.reason: ETP-5611 — line number column removed from the grid; still assigned server-side by the AD default (MAX(Line)+10) and used as the list order.

gLItems.reason: Multi-G/L account selector (Account_ID) — only relevant when Multi-General Ledger is on; out of scope for the simplified single-ledger journal.

accountingCombination.label: Account
accountingCombination.reason: Accounting combination (C_ValidCombination_ID) selector — the line's Account column. ETP-5210: explicit columnWidth (280px) so it renders wider than Description's 224px type default — neither field set a width before, and the foreignKey selector's 192px default rendered narrower than description's string default. ETP-5611: narrowed to 220px so Debit/Credit plus the hover-actions slot fit without horizontal scroll.

description.reason: ETP-5210 (revised scope) — line description column removed entirely from the grid and the line editor; header description (gLJournal.description) is unaffected and still covers journal-level notes. Frees the column width for accountingCombination (Account) to absorb via the existing flex-grow mechanism (linesColumnWidth.js).

foreignCurrencyDebit.reason: Debit amount (AmtSourceDr) — drives the balanceFooter Σ debit. Entering a value clears credit (mutually exclusive).

foreignCurrencyCredit.reason: Credit amount (AmtSourceCr) — drives the balanceFooter Σ credit. Entering a value clears debit (mutually exclusive). ETP-5611: noTrailing keeps Credit visible and clickable on hover — the row actions take their own slot instead of replacing the last amount column.

businessPartner.reason: ETP-4529 — raw AD passthrough (@Open_Items@='Y' | @ACCT_DIMENSION_DISPLAY@): keeps the Open-Items rule AND adds accounting-dimension config gating. dimensionsPanel: true routes it into the expand-row "Dimensiones contables" UX (previously absent from the lines grid entirely).

product.reason: ETP-4529 — accounting dimension, config-gated (@ACCT_DIMENSION_DISPLAY@). Supersedes the prior Open-Items-only override, which didn't match this field's raw AD display logic. dimensionsPanel: true routes it into the expand-row "Dimensiones contables" UX (previously absent from the lines grid entirely).

project.reason: ETP-4529 — accounting dimension, config-gated (@ACCT_DIMENSION_DISPLAY@). Supersedes the prior Open-Items-only override, which didn't match this field's raw AD display logic. dimensionsPanel: true routes it into the expand-row "Dimensiones contables" UX (previously absent from the lines grid entirely).

openItems.reason: Open Items checkbox — lives in the side-panel line editor; toggling it reveals the per-line dimensions (businessPartner/product/project/costCenter/asset). Source column is NOT NULL; defaults to false/unchecked ('N').
